head: Samsung Wallet QR code payments with Visa start in Australia and Singapore
dek: Galaxy phone owners in Australia and Singapore can now pay with a Visa card in Samsung Wallet by scanning a shop's QR code, Visa and Samsung announced on 16 November. More Asia Pacific countries are to follow over the next few quarters.
details: You swipe to open QR payments in Samsung Wallet, scan the merchant's code and approve. It works where shops show supported QR marks such as Alipay+, FOMO Pay, Lakala, VNPay, OpenRice or Octopus, depending on the place, including when you travel abroad. It's part of Visa Pay.
where: Australia and Singapore first, Samsung Wallet on Galaxy phones with a Visa card
means: If you have a Galaxy phone and a Visa card, you can pay at shops that only take QR codes, at home or abroad, without another payment app.
todo: Open Samsung Wallet and check that your Visa card is added; look for a supported QR mark at the till.

sources.name: The Manila Times (Visa and Samsung press release)
